"""Inference speedup benchmark: Dense vs RASP 20% vs Standard 20%."""
import torch
import time
import json
import argparse
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from datasets import load_dataset


def benchmark_model(model_path, prompts, max_new_tokens=512, device="cuda"):
    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path, trust_remote_code=True)
    if tokenizer.pad_token_id is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token_id = tokenizer.eos_token_id

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        model_path, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map=device, trust_remote_code=True
    )
    model.eval()

    # Warmup
    for p in prompts[:3]:
        inputs = tokenizer(p, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=50, do_sample=False)

    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    total_tokens = 0
    start = time.time()

    for i, p in enumerate(prompts):
        inputs = tokenizer(p, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = model.generate(
                **inputs, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, do_sample=False,
                eos_token_id=[151643, 151645]
            )
        generated_tokens = outputs.shape[1] - inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]
        total_tokens += generated_tokens
        if (i + 1) % 10 == 0:
            elapsed_so_far = time.time() - start
            print(f"  [{i+1}/{len(prompts)}] tokens={total_tokens}, elapsed={elapsed_so_far:.1f}s")

    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    elapsed = time.time() - start
    peak_mem = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() / 1024**3

    del model
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return {
        "total_time_sec": round(elapsed, 2),
        "total_tokens": total_tokens,
        "tokens_per_second": round(total_tokens / elapsed, 2),
        "avg_latency_per_prompt_sec": round(elapsed / len(prompts), 3),
        "peak_memory_gb": round(peak_mem, 2),
    }


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--dense_path", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--rasp_path", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--standard_path", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--n_prompts", type=int, default=50)
    parser.add_argument("--max_new_tokens", type=int, default=512)
    parser.add_argument("--output_path", default="/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/results/inference_benchmark.json")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    ds = load_dataset("openai/gsm8k", "main", split="test")
    prompts = [f"Question: {ex['question']}\nAnswer:" for ex in ds.select(range(args.n_prompts))]

    results = {}
    for name, path in [("dense", args.dense_path), ("rasp_20", args.rasp_path), ("standard_20", args.standard_path)]:
        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"Benchmarking: {name} ({path})")
        print(f"{'='*60}")
        results[name] = benchmark_model(path, prompts, args.max_new_tokens)
        results[name]["model_path"] = path
        print(json.dumps(results[name], indent=2))

    if results.get("dense") and results["dense"]["tokens_per_second"] > 0:
        dense_tps = results["dense"]["tokens_per_second"]
        dense_mem = results["dense"]["peak_memory_gb"]
        for key in ["rasp_20", "standard_20"]:
            if key in results:
                results[key]["speedup_vs_dense"] = round(results[key]["tokens_per_second"] / dense_tps, 3)
                results[key]["memory_reduction_vs_dense_pct"] = round(
                    (1 - results[key]["peak_memory_gb"] / dense_mem) * 100, 1
                )

    import os
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(args.output_path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(args.output_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {args.output_path}")
    print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
SCRIPT
